title: SDE3, Infrastructure Security Engineer (DevSecOps)
description:
**About the team**

Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.

The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails.

**About the role**

You are an infrastructure engineer whose first instinct is security, and who builds rather than only operates. You have worked on banking, fintech, payments or similarly regulated products, where a misconfiguration is an incident and an audit is routine. Here you set what “secure” means across Sarvam’s infrastructure and build the automation that enforces it, so security is a property of the pipeline rather than a review step. You work closely with the compliance team.

This is a hands-on role: most of your time goes into building, and you guide engineering teams across Sarvam on security — setting standards, reviewing security-relevant work and mentoring engineers.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and enforce security baselines for Kubernetes, cloud accounts, container images and CI/CD across all clouds
* Write the policy gates in the delivery pipeline (OPA / Conftest, Kyverno or equivalent): network exposure, IAM, image provenance, secrets, data residency
* Own secrets and workload identity: Vault or cloud-native equivalents, rotation, short-lived and scoped credentials, no long-lived keys
* Build detection and response: runtime security (Falco / Tetragon or equivalent), log-based detections, alerting and playbooks
* Run the finding-to-fix loop for security findings: triage, assign, fix, add a detection, retest
* Use LLMs and AI agents in security work: triaging findings, reviewing infrastructure changes, tuning detections, drafting incident timelines — and secure the agents themselves with scoped, short-lived permissions and audit trails
* Harden the supply chain: image signing and scanning, dependency policy, SBOMs
* Automate compliance evidence (CERT-In, ISO 27001, SOC 2, DPDP) together with the compliance team
* Set the security standards other engineers follow and review security-relevant changes
* Take part in on-call and lead security incidents

**Requirements**

* 5–9 years in DevOps, platform or security engineering, with at least 2 in a bank, fintech, payments company or other regulated environment
* Strong Kubernetes and Linux fundamentals; has run production clusters on at least one major cloud
* Hands-on with Terraform / OpenTofu and GitOps (ArgoCD or Flux)
* Has built security automation, not only operated tools: policy-as-code, secrets rotation, CI/CD security gates or detection pipelines
* Working knowledge of IAM, network security, TLS and secrets management across clouds
* Scripting and tooling in Python or Go
* Has been through security audits and knows what evidence auditors need
* Has built or used AI-based automation in infrastructure or security work, and understands the risks of AI agents: prompt injection, over-broad permissions, unreviewed actions
* Nice to have: Vault, SPIFFE / SPIRE, Falco or Tetragon, Cloudflare WAF, incident response lead experience, multi-cloud experience

title: IT Techno Functional Analyst
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Job Summary**

This role is responsible for the delivery, support, and continuous improvement of Transportation, Procurement, and Logistics IT solutions. The incumbent partners with business stakeholders, vendors, and IT teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure technology capabilities that enable critical supply chain operations.

The position participates in all phases of the solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution delivery, testing, implementation, production support, service management, and continuous improvement. The role contributes to operational excellence through automation, AI-enabled capabilities, process optimization, and data-driven decision making to improve business outcomes, service reliability, and user experience.

**What You Will Do: - Functional & Technical skills:**

* Strong knowledge of Supply Chain and Transportation Logistics, including international planning and execution, inbound and outbound transportation, multimodal operations (ocean, air, ground), freight visibility, analytics, consolidation, and network optimization.
* Experience with transportation platforms such as Blue Yonder (JDA) Transportation Management, E2open, Infor Nexus (GT Nexus), and related logistics technologies.
* Demonstrated Functional Analyst expertise with end-to-end product lifecycle ownership across Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Partner with business, operations, and product stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze processes, define functional and non-functional requirements, and develop solution designs aligned with business objectives.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
* Lead and support all phases of the product lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, release planning, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
* Manage and continuously improve transportation technology products through ServiceNow-based service management processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Knowledge, and Service Request Management.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and production issues within established service level agreements (SLAs), coordinating with business teams, vendors, and support partners.
* Support and coordinate major incident management, root cause analysis, problem resolution, and corrective action planning to improve system stability, resilience, and business continuity.
* Coordinate cybersecurity vulnerability management activities, including risk assessment, remediation planning, patch coordination, security compliance, audit support, and timely closure of application and infrastructure vulnerabilities in partnership with security, infrastructure, and vendor teams.
* Manage application maintenance, environment management, server patching, platform upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives to maintain secure, reliable, and compliant systems.
* Drive operational excellence through automation, AI-enabled capabilities, self-service solutions, intelligent monitoring, predictive analytics, and process optimization initiatives that improve efficiency, service quality, and user experience.
* Measure, monitor, and improve service performance, operational processes, standards, and support effectiveness using data-driven metrics and continuous improvement practices.
* Create and maintain comprehensive test strategies, test plans, regression suites, and validation processes to ensure solution quality and release readiness.
* Develop and maintain deep functional, operational, and technical knowledge of transportation processes, applications, integrations, and emerging industry trends.
* Working knowledge of modern application architecture, Java/J2EE technologies, Spring Framework, REST APIs, SQL, Oracle/Snowflake databases, OpenShift, DevOps practices, and distributed system troubleshooting.

**Additional Information**

Experience: 4+ years of IT experience in application development, support, services and product delivery

Education: BE / B Tech / MCA

Shift: Project dependent

* 1 PM IST to 10 PM IST (North America & Europe Operations)
* 7:30 AM IST to 4:30 PM IST (Asia Pacific Operations)
* Weekend deployment activities & support (On-demand – Monthly or emergency release)

**What You Have:**

**Operational & Behavioral Competencies:**

* Develop and maintain strong business, operational, and technical knowledge of transportation, procurement, and logistics processes and solutions.
* Effectively manage multiple assignments, projects, support activities, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Apply analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify issues, evaluate options, and recommend solutions.
* Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional IT teams.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrate accountability, ownership, and follow-through in assigned work and issue resolution.
* Adapt quickly to changing business priorities, technologies, and operational requirements.
* Demonstrate initiative, learning agility, customer focus, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**Top candidate might also have**

* Knowledge of Blue Yonder (JDA) TM, E2open, Infor Nexus (GT Nexus), and related transportation technologies.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM), Microsoft Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices.
* Knowledge of Java, Python, SQL, middleware technologies, APIs, and data formats such as REST, JSON, XML, and EDI.
* Understanding of SOA, messaging, and enterprise integration concepts.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications, incident and problem management, and production operations.
* Knowledge of automation, AI-enabled capabilities, observability, monitoring, and cybersecurity best practices.

The successful candidate will possess strong written and verbal communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions and support. The individual should be self-motivated, accountable, and capable of working independently while effectively collaborating with global business and IT teams. Flexibility to support global operations, production deployments, critical incidents, and continuous improvement initiatives is expected.

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of India which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers.

**What You Will Get:**

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

**Final Details:**

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization.

**About Caterpillar**

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

description:

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

**Principal Analyst, Business Intelligence Service Delivery:**

This role is responsible for leading development and support for the analytics solutions on SAP BW, Azure, Databricks, PBI and BPC. This individual is responsible for leading the business requirement gathering, design technical solutions, implementation, and optimization of solutions.

This role combines technical expertise with business acumen to ensure efficient and effective IT solutions delivery for analytics operations and automation.

This is an individual contributor role that requires the use of judgement in applying professional expertise and is expected to work independently with minimal supervision. This Job requires an understanding and application of procedures and concepts of own discipline, attention to detail in making evaluative judgements based on the analysis of information.

This role requires engaging and supporting global teams and business primarily in the US, good overlap hours required during working

**What you will do:**

* Design, build, test, and deliver scalable analytics and data solutions across SAP BW, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, and BPC, ensuring reliability, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Lead end-to-end analytics development and application support, ensuring successful delivery of solutions aligned with business requirements, technical standards, and enterprise data strategy.
* Partner with business, IT, global process governance, and project teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, considering security, scalability, stability, and long-term sustainability.
* Provide technical leadership to internal and vendor development teams, including solution design, hands-on development, code reviews, implementation, troubleshooting, and adherence to engineering best practices.
* Drive operational excellence by overseeing day-to-day application support and maintenance while identifying opportunities to improve system performance, process efficiency, and overall customer experience.
* Lead incident, problem, and root cause management, resolving complex technical issues and implementing corrective and preventive actions to improve application stability and service reliability.
* Transform support operations through automation, AI, self-service, and shift-left approaches, reducing manual effort and continuously improving service effectiveness and user experience.
* Own service excellence and continuous improvement, establishing service roadmaps, proactive monitoring, support procedures, and improvement initiatives based on stakeholder demand and customer feedback.
* Manage onshore/offshore teams and technology vendors, monitoring performance against agreed service expectations and driving accountability for high-quality development, support, and service delivery.
* Ensure strong governance and operational readiness through adherence to release management processes and maintenance of accurate system documentation, requirements, test scripts, knowledge articles, configuration information, and support procedures.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10-12 years of experience in data and analytics, including designing and developing scalable, high-quality solutions across SAP BW and Microsoft Azure platforms.
* Strong hands-on expertise with SAP BW, Databricks, Power BI, Azure Data Factory (ADF) and ETL technologies such as Informatica; SAP BW certification preferred.
* Strong production/application support experience, with strong capabilities in Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management, including root cause analysis and systematic troubleshooting.
* Proven experience translating business requirements into technical specifications and solutions, covering architecture, data flows, design, development, testing, documentation, deployment, and enhancements.
* Strong understanding of ITIL, SDLC, Agile, and Waterfall methodologies; ITIL Foundation v4 or equivalent certification preferred.
* Experience designing and supporting cross-application integrations involving SAP, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms, along with exposure to AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot.
* Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build strong internal/external relationships and simplify complex technical concepts into actionable plans; MedTech industry experience preferred.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Analyst II, Information Security
description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

09

**About the Role:** This role helps reduce the cyber risk posed by third parties and protects S&P Global brands against possible attacks against our information assets by threat actors via backdoor created by our vendors. Primary responsibilities will include assessing Cybersecurity, Business Continuity controls for S&P third parties by conducting control risk assessments, risk recertifications, and continuously monitoring the vendors engaged by S&P.

  

**The Team:**

As part of Vendor Risk Management, the Vendor Cyber Risk Management team manages the Supply Chain Cyber risks by performing risk assessments of third-party engagements to identify and reduce the risks posed by third parties. This is an extremely important role, considering the fact that large number of data breaches happen due to third parties. It involves working with internal stake holders as well as third parties to achieve the results.

  

**Responsibilities and Impact:**

Working in Vendor Risk Management offers the opportunity to continuously enhance processes to meet the evolving requirements of various regulators. This challenging environment provides ample opportunities to expand your knowledge and expertise.

  

In addition to risk assessments, recertifications, and continuous monitoring, you will participate in various projects, allowing you to showcase and further develop your skills and experience.

  

Key responsibilities:

* Conduct thorough Cybersecurity, Business Continuity, Artificial Intelligence assessments for various vendors such as Cloud Service Prover evaluating their information security policies, procedures, and controls.
* Effectively collaborate with internal teams to identify critical vendors and assess their potential impact on the organization's cyber risk profile.
* Communicate risk assessment findings and recommendations to key stakeholders, including senior management, legal, and compliance teams.
* Work closely with vendors to address identified security gaps and ensure they meet the organization's cybersecurity requirements.
* Review the vendors on the continuous monitoring program utilizing various attack surface monitoring tools and assisting in driving the periodical review the vendors.
* Monitor and stay abreast of evolving cybersecurity threats and industry trends to enhance the effectiveness of the risk assessment process.
* Review the cyber security contracts for various clauses to cover for data Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability.
* Lead and support enhancement and strategic projects aligning with business objectives within Vendor Risk Management to meet various business and regulatory requirements.
* Assist the team members in balancing the load and managing Ad-hoc projects.
* Where required, lead the team for BAU (Business as Usual) tasks mentioned above.
  

  

**What We’re Looking For:**

**Basic Required Qualifications:**

* Master/bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent
* 6+ years of experience in Information Security or Technology Risk Management
* Any prior exposure to Cyber vendor risk management and/ or privacy laws and regulations is a plus.
* Demonstrable understanding of the concepts of technology controls and information security controls.
* Exposure to cloud technologies and cloud security is highly desired; the familiarity with public cloud technologies such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is highly preferred.
* Exposure to Attack Surface Monitoring tools is a plus.
* Exposure to vendor cyber security contracts is highly desired.
* Excellent communication skills - a must. The resource should have the ability to communicate with cross-functional teams and vendors, both written and oral communication is critical.
  

  

**Additional Preferred Qualifications:**

* This position is required to work in UK Shift; flexibility is a must, especially when it comes to vendor and internal meetings held during US business hours.
  + Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize while maintaining close attention to detail.
  + Ability to build strategic partnerships with internal stakeholders.
  + Must be a critical thinker with strong qualitative skills.
* Information Security/Risk Management certification would be an advantage.

* Plan, schedule, and execute vulnerability scans across network, endpoint, server, and cloud environments using tools such as Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7 InsightVM, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
* Perform authenticated and unauthenticated scans, ensuring coverage across all in-scope assets.
* Conduct ad hoc scans following remediation activities to validate closure of identified vulnerabilities.
* Maintain and continuously improve scan coverage, ensuring no asset gaps in the vulnerability programme.

**Analysis & Risk Prioritisation**

* Analyse scan results and assess vulnerabilities based on CVSS scores, exploit availability, asset criticality, and business impact.
* Correlate vulnerability findings with threat intelligence feeds to identify actively exploited vulnerabilities that require expedited remediation.
* Differentiate and prioritise Critical, High, Medium, and Low severity vulnerabilities in line with client SLAs and organisational risk appetite.
* Provide contextual risk analysis beyond automated scoring, considering the environment and compensating controls in place.

**Remediation Management & Follow-up**

* Assign remediation tasks to relevant resolver teams and track progress through to closure.
* Conduct regular follow-up with resolver teams to ensure patch deployment, configuration changes, or compensating controls are applied within agreed timelines.
* Escalate overdue or high-risk items to management and client stakeholders as appropriate.
* Validate remediation completeness through rescan confirmation and update records accordingly.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Prepare and deliver monthly, weekly, and ad hoc vulnerability management reports for client and internal stakeholders, including trend analysis, SLA performance, and risk posture summaries.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date vulnerability records across ticketing and vulnerability management platforms.
* Support governance meetings, monthly business reviews, and audit activities with relevant vulnerability data and evidence.
* Track and report on KPIs such as mean time to remediate (MTTR), vulnerability age, and scan coverage.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a point of contact for client queries related to vulnerability findings, remediation status, and risk assessment.
* Provide guidance and recommendations to resolver teams and clients on remediation approaches, patch management, and risk acceptance.
* Participate in client calls and governance forums, presenting vulnerability posture and remediation progress clearly and concisely.

**Process Improvement & Documentation**

* Maintain and continuously improve vulnerability management SOPs, playbooks, and process documentation.
* Identify opportunities to automate or streamline scanning, reporting, and remediation tracking workflows.
* Stay current with emerging vulnerabilities, CVEs, threat actor activity, and vendor advisories, and communicate relevant intelligence to the team and stakeholders.
* Support tool evaluations, onboarding of new scan targets, and integration of new clients or entities into the vulnerability programme.

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

* 4–6 years of experience in cybersecurity with at least 2–3 years focused on vulnerability management.
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning tools — Nessus Professional, Qualys, Rapid7 InsightVM, Defender or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of network protocols, operating systems (Windows, Linux), and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with ITSM and ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow for remediation tracking.
* Strong analytical and report-writing skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences.
* Experience working in a managed security services or client-facing environment is preferred.

title: Chief Data Office - Records Retention & Destruction - Associate
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

*Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast-paced, challenging area? This is a unique opportunity to partner with business and control functions, strengthen information lifecycle governance, and help deliver a comprehensive, auditable approach to records retention and destruction.*

Business / Team Overview

The Retention and Destruction function is responsible for enabling compliant information lifecycle management across physical and electronic records. The team partners with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, and business stakeholders to ensure records are retained according to approved schedules, placed on hold when required, and destroyed in a controlled, auditable manner when eligible.

Job Summary

As Records Retention & Destruction Analyst (602) within the Retention and Destruction team, you will be responsible for supporting the execution and oversight of compliant records retention and destruction processes. You will coordinate retention schedule adherence, disposition reviews, legal holds, evidence collection, and operational reporting across physical and electronic records. You will partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, data stewards, and business stakeholders to resolve exceptions and maintain audit-ready documentation. You will also help strengthen controls, improve procedures, and advance automation for defensible information lifecycle management.

Job Responsibilities

* Execute day-to-day retention and destruction activities for in-scope records (electronic and/or physical), ensuring eligibility and approvals are met prior to disposition.
* Support adherence to approved retention schedules by coordinating with record owners, data stewards, and technology partners.
* Assist with **legal hold** processes: intake, implementation support, tracking, release coordination, and validation of hold effectiveness.
* Perform disposition reviews, sampling, and quality checks to confirm correct classification, retention calculations, and exception handling.
* Maintain auditable evidence for disposition decisions and completion of destruction activities, including chain-of-custody where applicable.
* Track and remediate exceptions (e.g., retention conflicts, unknown owners, incomplete metadata, hold impacts), escalating issues through defined governance channels.
* Produce operational reporting and metrics (e.g., backlog, eligible-for-destruction volumes, holds coverage, exception trends, cycle times).
* Contribute to process documentation: SOPs, runbooks, control narratives, and training materials.
* Participate in risk and control activities, including periodic attestations, internal reviews, and audit/exam support.
* Collaborate with technology teams to improve automation for disposition workflows, retention tagging, and defensible destruction.

Required Qualifications, Skills, and Capabilities

* Demonstrated experience in records management, information governance, compliance operations, risk and controls, or a related operational role.
* Working knowledge of records lifecycle principles, including retention schedules, disposition, legal holds, defensible destruction, and auditability.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow controlled processes while maintaining accurate, audit-ready evidence.
* Proven ability to analyze data and metadata, determine retention eligibility, and identify or resolve exceptions.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and basic reporting, with the ability to work effectively with large datasets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across business, legal, compliance, risk, and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced production environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with electronic records and content management systems and/or eDiscovery and legal hold tooling.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory exams, or formal control testing activities.
* Exposure to data classification, data lineage/ownership, and metadata quality practices.
* Understanding of privacy and data protection considerations as they relate to retention and destruction.
* Experience improving operational processes (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent continuous improvement methods).

Competencies

* Control-minded execution and operational discipline
* Sound judgment and escalation when eligibility/approvals are unclear
* Stakeholder management and collaborative problem-solving
* Documentation rigor and continuous improvement orientation

title: Ent. & Bus. Applications Senior Analyst
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Azure Integration Specialist with a minimum of 9 years of experience in architecting, developing, and managing enterprise integration solutions on Microsoft Azure. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Azure integration services, automation, security, and DevOps practices. This role involves designing seamless integrations, ensuring security and compliance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive business outcomes.
  
Core Azure Integration Skills
  
**Azure Logic Apps:** Designing workflows to automate business processes.
  
**Azure API Management:** Creating, publishing, securing, and monitoring APIs.
  
**Azure Service Bus:** Implementing messaging patterns for decoupled systems.
  
**Azure Functions:** Writing serverless code for event-driven integrations.
  
**Event Grid Event Hub:** Handling real-time event streaming and routing.
  
**Data Factory:** Building and managing data pipelines for ETL processes.
  
**Azure Services Proficiency:** Deep understanding of core services like Azure Virtual Machines, App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, and Azure Networking.
  
**Scripting Automation:** Proficiency in PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Python for automating tasks.
  
**Networking:** Knowledge of VNETs, NSGs, VPN Gateways, ExpressRoute, and Load Balancers.
  
**Security:** Familiarity with Azure AD, RBAC, Managed Identities, Key Vault, and Security Center.
  
**Monitoring Logging:** Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  
Integration Middleware Knowledge
  
**BizTalk Server:** Understanding legacy integration patterns and migration to Azure.
  
**REST/SOAP APIs:** Consuming and exposing APIs securely.
  
**JSON, XML, XSLT:** Working with data formats and transformations.
  
**OAuth2, OpenID Connect:** Implementing secure authentication and authorization.
  
DevOps Automation
  
**CI/CD Pipelines:** Using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for deployment automation.
  
**Infrastructure as Code:** Using ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform.
  
**Monitoring Logging:** Leveraging Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics.
  
Data Integration Design
  
**Integration Patterns:** Understanding messaging, orchestration, and choreography.
  
**Error Handling Retry Logic:** Designing resilient integrations.
  
**Security Compliance:** Ensuring data protection and regulatory compliance.
  
Certifications (Recommended)
  
**Microsoft Certified:** Azure Developer Associate
  
**Microsoft Certified:** Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  
**Microsoft Certified:** Integration Solutions Architect (if available)
  
Soft Skills
  
**Analytical Thinking:** Solving complex integration challenges.
  
**Communication:** Collaborating with developers, architects, and business stakeholders.
  
**Documentation:** Creating clear integration specs and support guides.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.

At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

### **Your day-to-day:**

* Support and maintain the Business Systems function at Greenlight
* Apply growing systems knowledge (NetSuite, Maxio, HubSpot, etc.) to troubleshoot and resolve technical and functional issues
* Configure and support solutions (i.e. automations, IPaaS, etc.) that improve billing, procurement, accounts receivable, accounts payable, General Ledger, and T&E operations, ensuring alignment with business requirements
* Contribute to Month End and Quarter End processes, and help bring efficiencies to business processes through systems
* Help optimize business processes and workflows by supporting integrations and automations across Business Systems
* Administer and maintain business systems (NetSuite, FloQast, Workiva, HubSpot, Maxio, ZIP, etc.), supporting optimal performance and alignment with business goals
* Perform daily business systems administration duties, including user and role maintenance, configuration maintenance, and integration maintenance
* Execute and support IT General Controls (ITGC) initiatives, including (but not limited to), access review, procedural documentation, business system change management, etc.
* Document system configurations and system processes
* Collaborate with global IT team members to support business systems
* Partner with the Security team to help strengthen the security posture of business systems
* Contribute to system enhancements and share feedback to support ongoing improvement

### **What you’ll bring to the team:**

* 7+ years of experience as a NetSuite administrator or business systems analyst
* NetSuite Administrator Certification preferred
* Working knowledge of SuiteBuilder; familiarity with SuiteScript and SuiteTalk
* Exposure to the SuiteCloud Development Framework and version control systems (e.g., GitHub)
* Familiarity with NetSuite modules such as Fixed Assets and OneWorld is a plus
* Some experience integrating NetSuite with other financial and business systems, or a strong interest in learning
* Experience supporting other financial systems that perform billing, reconciliation, travel management, revenue recognition, and CRM functions is a plus (e.g., FloQast, Workiva, HubSpot, Maxio)
* Exposure to global or multi-entity system environments is a plus
* Understanding of ITGCs and exposure to SOC, ISO, or SOX compliant environments
* Familiarity with core accounting processes such as order to cash, procure to pay, and record to report
* Exposure to agile project management tools such as Jira, Asana, Confluence, and LucidChart
* Accounting or Finance background is a plus
* Exposure to no-code automation or IPaaS platforms (e.g., StackSync, UiPath) is a plus
* Have experience with using AI to enhance and optimize accounting, finance, and business systems process is a plus
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and troubleshoot issues and support solutions from design to implementation
* A proactive attitude with a desire to learn new skills in a flexible, fast-paced environment

**Who we are:**

It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.

Greenlight is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on age, race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

Greenlight is committed to an inclusive work environment and interview experience. If you require reasonable accommodations to participate in our hiring process, please reach out to your recruiter directly or email accomodations@greenlight.me.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Information Security Analyst
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Information Security Analyst.

**In this role, you will:**

* Provide information security consultation to improve awareness and compliance with Enterprise Information Security policy, processes and standards
* Perform remediation of security assessment review issues, complex ad hoc data, and reporting to support information security risk management
* Provide guidance and direction in reviewing assessment findings and mitigating controls to optimize information security
* Identify and direct information asset portfolio reconciliations and certifications
* Provide advanced data aggregation and data of information security risk exposure
* Develop and deliver Information Security Education Awareness and Training in accordance with the Enterprise Information Security Program standards
* Review draft and proposed control standards for business impact and recommend modifications or clarifications as required
* Conduct security control testing and consultation with stakeholders
* Evaluate and interpret internal and Enterprise Information Security policies, processes and standards, and provide recommendations to improve them
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
* Interact with internal customers
* Serve as a mentor to less experienced staff

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of Information Security Analysis experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of experience in information security, Identity and Access Management, data analytics, workflow automation, or a combination of these areas.
* Three or more years of experience supporting IAM processes such as provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews and certifications, authentication, authorization, entitlement management, or identity lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience developing Power BI dashboards, data models, visualizations, operational metrics, and executive-ready reporting.
* Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, validation, and analysis.
* Experience analyzing data from multiple sources, identifying trends and anomalies, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Experience translating business and operational requirements into reporting specifications, business rules, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, exception management, testing, and production-support practices.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex IAM, security, risk, and data concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage assigned deliverables while collaborating across multiple teams.
* Hands-on experience developing Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, reconciliation, reporting, or process automation.
* Experience using Python for data processing, analytics, automation, validation, or exception handling.
* Experience supporting IAM controls, risk assessments, audits, issue remediation, or evidence collection.
* Experience with Agile delivery practices and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Experience establishing reporting standards, metric definitions, data dictionaries, and data-quality controls.
* Experience with source control, peer review, release management, and production monitoring for analytics or automation solutions.
* Experience presenting operational, risk, control, or data insights to senior leadership.
* Knowledge of cloud identity platforms, identity governance solutions, privileged access management, or access-management technologies.

**Job Expectations:**

* Ability to independently manage assigned analytics, reporting, automation, and process improvement workstreams.
* Ability to work with complex and potentially sensitive information security and identity data in accordance with applicable policies, standards, and data-handling requirements.
* Ability to document solutions sufficiently to support testing, implementation, production support, maintenance, and knowledge transfer.
* Ability to collaborate with geographically and functionally diverse stakeholders across business, technology, risk, product, and operations teams.
* Ability to support production reporting and automation solutions by investigating failures, data discrepancies, and operational issues.
* Ability to communicate risks, dependencies, issues, and recommendations clearly and promptly.

**Posting End Date:**

8 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

title: GRC Analyst
description:
**About the Role**

R360 (Reward360 Global Services) operates one of the denser multi-framework compliance stacks in the Indian BFSI-adjacent fintech space, maintaining concurrent conformance to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 20000-1, SOC 2 (Type I/II), India's DPDP Act 2023, and PCI DSS v4.0.1 in addition to bank-specific vendor security requirements from clients including HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank. As GRC Analyst, you will own control implementation, evidence collection, risk register maintenance, and audit coordination across this stack, working closely with AppSec, DevOps/Infra, and client-facing InfoSec teams to keep certifications live and the organization continuously audit-ready.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. ISMS Ownership & Certification Maintenance (ISO/IEC 27001:2022)

* Maintain the Statement of Applicability (SoA), risk treatment plan, and control implementation evidence.
* Support internal audits, management review meetings, and surveillance/recertification audits with external certification bodies.

2. Privacy Management (ISO/IEC 27701 + DPDP Act 2023)

* Maintain the Privacy Information Management System (PIMS) extension to the ISMS.
* Maintain Records of Processing Activities (ROPA), consent-flow mapping, and data-principal-rights handling against DPDP Act 2023 obligations (consent manager touchpoints, breach notification timelines, Data Fiduciary/Processor duties).
* Support Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for new features, products, and vendors handling personal data.

3. IT Service Management (ISO/IEC 20000-1)

* Maintain ITSM process documentation — incident, problem, change, capacity, and service level management — aligned to ISO/IEC 20000-1 requirements.
* Coordinate with DevOps/Infra on service management metrics and supporting audit evidence.

4. SOC 2 Readiness & Audit Support

* Maintain Trust Services Criteria control matrices (security, availability, confidentiality, and processing integrity /privacy where applicable).
* Coordinate auditor evidence requests across SOC 2 Type I (point-in-time) and Type II (operating effectiveness over a review period) engagements.

5. PCI DSS v4.0.1 Compliance

* Maintain Attestation of Compliance (AoC) / Report on Compliance (RoC) documentation and BAU evidence (Requirements 1–12).
* Track compensating controls, quarterly ASV scan remediation, and annual penetration test finding closurealongside the AppSec team.

6. Risk & Third-Party Risk Management

* Maintain the enterprise risk register; run risk assessments for new projects, products, and vendor/third-party integrations.
* Support responses to client-facing vendor security questionnaires from banking clients (HDFC, ICICI, Kotak, and others).

7. Policy, Awareness & Change Governance

* Draft and maintain InfoSec policies, standards, and procedures; run security awareness training and track completion metrics.
* Provide GRC input into the PCCB (internal change control gate) process for compliance-impacting changes.

8. Regulatory Reporting & Metrics

* Support RBI regulatory reporting and CERT-In incident reporting timelines where GRC input is required.
* Build and maintain compliance dashboards/KPIs for leadership and board-level reporting.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, IT, Law, Business, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of hands-on GRC / compliance / IT audit experience, ideally in BFSI, fintech, SaaS, or another regulated environment.
* Working knowledge of at least 2–3 of the following, with demonstrated ability to ramp on the remainder within 90 days: ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 20000-1, SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, PCI DSS v4.0.1, DPDP Act 2023.
* Familiarity with GRC tooling (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, OneTrust, Vanta, Drata, or equivalent) is a plus.
* Understanding of risk assessment methodologies (qualitative and quantitative; FAIR exposure is a plus).
* Strong documentation discipline policies, SOPs, audit evidence packages that hold up under external QSA/auditor scrutiny.
* Experience directly coordinating with external auditors, QSAs, or certification bodies is a strong plus.

Preferred Certifications

* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
* CDPSE (Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer)
* ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Implementer
* CIPP/E or CIPM (privacy)
* PCI DSS Internal Security Assessor (ISA)

title: Data Management & Governance Program Lead
description:
**Data Management & Governance Program Lead**

**Role summary**

**Job title**

Data Management & Governance Program Lead

**Engagement**

Enterprise data management programme for a life insurer: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI readiness and BAU handover

**Reports to**

Engagement Director - Capvirge; works day to day with the client’s Deputy CTO

**Leads**

Project Manager, Project Coordinator, Data Governance Analyst, Data Quality & Lineage Analyst, Business Analyst, Power BI Developers and Snowflake Data Engineer (with the client EDO team)

**Experience**

12–15+ years in data and analytics; 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes

**Purpose of the role**

The Program Lead designs, gets approved and hands over a complete data management framework, so the business trusts its numbers and can run it without the vendor after Go-Live.

The role owns nine strategic deliverables, from KPI definitions to BAU transition, and steers the client’s EDO team on day-to-day data operations and dashboard delivery. Success means one agreed meaning for every KPI, a named owner for every data asset, proven data quality, and a client team that runs it all on its own.

The role also oversees delivery of the **16 tactical dashboards** (Power BI on Snowflake), from BRD and build to UAT sign-off, Production and BAU.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and frameworks**

* Write and maintain the data management frameworks: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI and automation readiness, handover, committee governance and BAU transition.

* Present frameworks and decision papers to the Steering Committee, the Data Management Committee and the Design Authority, and secure approval at each gate.

**KPIs and data governance**

* Run KPI definition workshops with each department; agree one definition, formula and owner per KPI; build the KPI Dictionary.

* Set up the governance operating model: Data Owners and Stewards, decision rights, policy, standards, data classification and committees.

**Data quality, lineage and platform**

* Identify critical data elements, define quality rules and thresholds, and set up monitoring, issue management and lineage.

* Assess the data platform (Snowflake, AWS, Power BI) for architecture, security, cost and environments; recommend a future state and remediation roadmap.

**Analytics and AI readiness**

* Map customer journeys and funnels; design reusable shared data sets for dashboards and reports.

* Assess AI readiness, rank automation and AI use cases, and set responsible AI and GenAI safety rules.

**Delivery and operations**

* Own the programme plan, RAID log, decision log, evidence repository and status reporting.

* Oversee the dashboard pipeline from BRD to UAT, Production and hypercare; unblock sign-offs with business owners.

* Guide the client EDO team on platform stability, incident and change processes, and the data request SOPs.

**Handover and BAU**

* Design BAU services, SOPs and service levels; train owners, stewards and the EDO team; lead handover acceptance and Go-Live readiness.

**Team the role leads**

**Role**

**Focus**

**Project Manager**

Programme plan, RAID log, action tracker and status reporting

**Project Coordinator**

Meetings, follow-ups, minutes and document control

**Data Governance Analyst**

Data Owners and Stewards, business glossary, policies and standards (D2)

**Data Quality & Lineage Analyst**

Data inventory, quality rules, monitoring and lineage (D3)

**Business Analyst (insurance)**

BRDs, KPI definitions and dashboard requirements (D1, D5)

**Power BI Developers**

Build, UAT and BAU support for the 16 dashboards

**Snowflake Data Engineer**

Data models, pipelines and platform remediation (D4)

**Required experience and qualifications**

* 12–15+ years in data and analytics, including 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes end to end.

* 5+ years in insurance or financial services; life insurance strongly preferred.

* Has set up a data governance operating model (owners, stewards, decision rights, committees) and taken it through executive approval.

* Has standardized KPIs across business units and built a KPI or business glossary used in production reporting.

* Has delivered a data quality programme with critical data elements, rules, thresholds and lineage.

* Has led a platform or architecture assessment and a remediation roadmap on a modern cloud data stack.

* Has handed a programme over to a BAU team, with SOPs, training and acceptance.

* Experience as a consultant or vendor lead working with client executives.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, statistics, business or a related field; a master’s degree is a plus.

**Technical and domain skills**

**Area**

**Must have**

**Good to have**

**Data governance**

DAMA-DMBOK, federated operating models, RACI and decision rights, data classification

DCAM, data catalogue tools

**KPIs and metrics**

KPI trees, SMART definitions, certification and change control

Management scorecards and target setting

**Data quality and lineage**

Critical data elements, quality dimensions, rules and thresholds, issue management, column lineage

Automated quality checks in pipelines (Airflow), logical data models

title: GRC Intern
description:
About the Role

R360 maintains concurrent conformance to six major compliance frameworks ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 20000-1, SOC 2, India's DPDP Act 2023, and PCI DSS v4.0.1 across a banking-linked platform serving HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank. This paid internship gives you structured, mentored exposure to real audit cycles, evidence collection, and control-testing work across all six frameworks a depth of multi-framework exposure that is uncommon at entry level, under the direct supervision of senior GRC analysts.

Key Responsibilities (Under Supervision)

* Assist in evidence collection for ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 20000-1, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and DPDP Act compliance activities.
* Support risk register updates and control-testing sample pulls.
* Assist with policy and procedure documentation reviews and version control.
* Support first-draft responses to vendor/client security questionnaires, reviewed by a senior GRC analyst before submission.
* Assist with audit logistics scheduling, evidence repository organisation, and auditor request tracking.
* Learn ROPA and DPIA basics under supervision as part of DPDP Act 2023 compliance work.
* Support security awareness training tracking and completion reporting.
* Assist with PCCB documentation review to flag compliance-relevant changes.

Learning Outcomes

* Real-world exposure to six concurrent compliance frameworks inside a live BFSI-adjacent environment.
* Understanding of the full audit lifecycle preparation, evidence collection, auditor coordination, and closure.
* Foundational GRC skills that map directly to a GRC Analyst career path.

Eligibility

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Information Security, IT, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of information security and/or data privacy concepts; relevant coursework or in-progress certifications are a plus.
* Detail-oriented with strong written English for documentation-heavy work.
* GRC — Governance, Risk & Compliance Hiring
* Genuine interest in a compliance/audit career path (as distinct from a purely technical/offensive-security track).

Preferred (Not Mandatory)

* ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation certificate, or actively pursuing one.
* Exposure to privacy law coursework (DPDP Act 2023, GDPR) is a plus.
* Comfort with Excel/Google Sheets and, ideally, some exposure to a GRC tool (ServiceNow GRC, OneTrust, Vanta, or similar).

Program Structure

1. Month 1–2 Foundations

Framework overview across ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 20000-1, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and DPDP Act 2023; shadowing GRC analysts; tool walk throughs.

2. Month 3–4 Guided Evidence Collection

Hands-on evidence collection and control-testing support, with mandatory senior review before submission.

3. Month 5–6 Supervised Independence

Independent ownership of low-risk documentation/evidence tasks (reviewed); capstone project — build one control-mapping matrix or mini gap-analysis across two frameworks.

title: GRC Security Analyst
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Governance**

* Assist in the development, review, and maintenance of information security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines in line with frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST CSF.
* Support periodic policy review cycles, ensuring documentation is kept current, version-controlled, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
* Contribute to security awareness initiatives by preparing training materials, tracking completion rates, and maintaining associated records.
* Maintain governance trackers and document repositories, ensuring accuracy and completeness at all times.
* Support the preparation of governance reports, dashboards, and meeting packs for internal and client stakeholders.

**Risk Management**

* Support the conduct of information security risk assessments under the guidance of senior team members, contributing to the identification and evaluation of threats, vulnerabilities, and business impacts.
* Maintain and update the risk register, ensuring risks are accurately documented, assigned, and tracked through treatment to closure.
* Assist with third-party and vendor risk assessments by gathering required information, reviewing responses, and documenting findings.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery documentation, review cycles, and testing activities.
* Help prepare risk reports and escalate identified risks to senior analysts or management as appropriate.

**Compliance**

* Support compliance activities against applicable frameworks and standards including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and client-specific requirements.
* Assist in the planning and coordination of internal and external audits — gathering evidence, preparing documentation packages, and tracking audit findings through to remediation.
* Conduct periodic compliance checks and control walkthroughs to verify that controls are in place and operating as expected.
* Maintain compliance calendars and support the team in meeting regulatory deadlines, audit schedules, and periodic review obligations.
* Track and follow up on corrective action plans arising from audit findings, ensuring timely closure and accurate record-keeping.

**Security Control Assessment**

* Assist in conducting periodic assessments of security controls across people, process, and technology dimensions.
* Document control observations, gaps, and weaknesses identified during assessments and support the preparation of remediation recommendations.
* Coordinate with technical and operational teams to gather evidence of control effectiveness and maintain supporting records for audit readiness.

**Reporting & Metrics**

* Maintain and update GRC dashboards, trackers, and metrics on a regular basis, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* Prepare routine GRC reports, meeting packs, and status updates for review by senior analysts or management before distribution to clients.
* Track and report on KPIs including policy compliance rates, open risk items, audit finding closure timelines, and training completion rates.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support client-facing GRC activities including governance meetings, monthly business reviews, and audit sessions under the guidance of senior team members.
* Respond to client queries on policy, compliance, and risk matters accurately and in a timely manner, escalating complex queries where appropriate.
* Maintain a professional and collaborative relationship with client security and compliance contacts.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and flag opportunities to improve GRC processes, templates, and documentation practices.
* Stay current with developments in security frameworks, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, and share relevant updates with the team.
* Support the adoption of GRC tools and contribute to improving data quality and workflow efficiency within those platforms.

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

* 2–4 years of experience in information security with exposure to governance, risk, and/or compliance functions.
* Working knowledge of at least one or two information security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or PCI-DSS.
* Basic understanding of risk assessment methodologies and the ability to identify and document security risks with guidance.
* Familiarity with audit processes — evidence gathering, control walkthroughs, and finding documentation.
* Ability to contribute to the development and review of security policies and procedures.
* Good analytical skills with attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation and tracking.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for report preparation, tracker maintenance, and presentation development.
* Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey security and compliance information clearly.
* Exposure to GRC platforms or ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, RSA Archer, or equivalent is an advantage.
* Experience in a managed security services or client-facing environment is a plus.
    
    
  **Preferred Certifications**
* CompTIA Security+
* ISO 27001 Foundation or Internal Auditor
* Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC) — Associate level
* CISM or CISSP — Foundation / Associate level
* Any vendor-specific GRC tool certification is a plus

title: Principal Agentic Security Engineer
description:
**SECURITY ENGINEERING AT INVESTCLOUD**

At InvestCloud, we are building an intelligent security response capability that determines what to fix first based on the actual risk to our clients and business, not a scanner's native severity.  
  
Traditional vulnerability management produces disconnected findings and long backlogs. It often misses whether vulnerable code is deployed, reachable by an attacker, connected to a critical service, capable of lateral movement, or already being exploited. We are solving that problem by combining threat intelligence, runtime and deployment evidence, configuration management data, attack path analysis, business criticality, and validation results.  
  
The platform will ingest findings from infrastructure, cloud, application, software supply chain, secrets, containers, infrastructure as code, and adversarial testing. It will reconcile them to a canonical asset and service model, deduplicate them into unique exposures, and rank the remediation actions that remove the most risk.  
  
The product is being built in Python on AWS with source-controlled connectors, deterministic policy code, an AI reasoning layer, human approval gates, complete audit evidence, and closed-loop validation. Large language models (LLMs) can correlate evidence, recommend remediation, and explain decisions. They do not calculate the authoritative priority score.  
  
This is not another scanner or dashboard. It is a security decision and remediation platform that must answer one question reliably: what is the single next action that will remove the most material risk, why is it first, who owns it, and how will we verify the risk is gone? Every engineer on this team will build production software, operate what they build, and own the product after the initial consultant implementation.

**THE ROLE**

As our Agentic Security Engineer, you will serve as the principal software architect for the harness and own the AI reasoning layer that turns prioritized exposures into evidence-grounded remediation options, residual risk analysis, and clear explanations.  
  
You will ensure the product operates as a reliable system, not an AI demonstration. The deterministic policy engine owns the authoritative score. The LLM layer retrieves evidence, correlates likely root causes, evaluates mitigation choices, produces structured recommendations, and knows when to abstain or require a human. You will also set engineering standards across Python services, APIs, data contracts, the evaluation framework, observability, and the operator experience.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

* **Product Technical Architecture:** Own the end-to-end software architecture for the Python and AWS product, including service boundaries, FastAPI and client APIs, the React or TypeScript operator interface, data contracts, Aurora PostgreSQL integration, security controls, performance, resilience, testability, and technical debt. Review and approve material design changes.
* **AI Reasoning & Tool Orchestration:** Build reliable, stateful workflows that retrieve evidence, call deterministic tools, correlate findings, identify root causes, compare remediation options, and return schema-validated recommendations with citations and confidence.
* **Grounding, Retrieval & Provenance:** Ground every output in current CMDB, threat intelligence, scanner evidence, code and deployment context, policy, and remediation history. Preserve source, observation time, freshness, model version, prompts, tool calls, and output evidence without inventing facts.
* **Evaluation, Safety & Confidence:** Create representative test sets and automated evaluations for accuracy, completeness, unsafe actions, hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, model drift, and confidence calibration. Implement fallback, abstention, and deterministic validation when evidence is weak.
* **Human Oversight & Controlled Autonomy:** Implement approval workflows, policy gate integration, exceptions, kill switches, audit capture, and separation of duties. Support an initial recommendation mode, then controlled automation only after actions are proven safe, reversible, and approved.
* **Technical Leadership & Product Ownership:** Set coding, testing, observability, documentation, and secure development standards for the team. Mentor engineers, challenge vendor assumptions, maintain provider independence, manage cost and latency, and lead the full handover from the consultant.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 12+ years in software, AI, or security engineering, with principal-level evidence of architecture, delivery, and technical leadership. You must have shipped production AI or LLM systems and possess enough security depth to evaluate remediation safely.
* Expert production Python and backend engineering, including FastAPI, Pydantic or JSON Schema, asynchronous workflows, APIs, SQL or PostgreSQL, distributed systems, automated testing, CI/CD, and AWS.
* Production LLM and agentic workflow experience using Bedrock, Claude, OpenAI, LangGraph, or equivalent. You have built durable tools using systems with explicit state, retries, timeouts, validation, and failure recovery, not demos.
* Evaluation and AI security depth, including gold data sets, offline and online metrics, hallucination controls, prompt injection defenses, data isolation, model routing, observability, confidence calibration, and safe abstention.
* Retrieval and knowledge engineering across structured and unstructured data. You understand when relational queries, search, rules, or vector retrieval are appropriate and can preserve provenance and freshness.
* Security engineering depth across application, cloud, infrastructure, vulnerability intelligence, attack paths, remediation, and compensating controls. You can identify when an AI proposal is incomplete, unsafe, or simply wrong.
* A high ownership builder who maintains current expertise through self-directed work, uses AI to multiply output without lowering rigor, communicates complex designs concisely, mentors others, and collaborates without ego.

**CORE TOOLING & TECHNOLOGIES**

Python · FastAPI · Pydantic / JSON Schema · LangGraph or equivalent · AWS Bedrock · Claude / OpenAI · PostgreSQL / Aurora · RAG and search · REST / GraphQL · React / TypeScript familiarity · GitLab CI · pytest · OpenTelemetry / Datadog · Jira / JSM · AWS

**WHY JOIN THIS TEAM**

You will define whether this becomes a trustworthy security product or an impressive prototype. The role combines principal software architecture, applied AI, and security judgment at a level rarely available in one position.  
  
Your work will make the platform explainable, testable, provider-independent, and safe enough to support controlled automation over time.

description:
Job Description:

Schneider Electric’s purpose is to **empower all to make the most of our energy and resources, bridging progress and sustainability** for all. We call this **Life Is On**.

We drive digital transformation by integrating world-leading process and energy technologies, end-point to cloud connecting products, controls, software and services, across the entire lifecycle, enabling integrated company management, for homes, buildings, data centers, infrastructure and industries.
