title: Senior Fraud QA and Enablement Analyst
description:
We are seeking a **Fraud Operations QA & Enablement analyst** to join our 24×7 fraud operations function and help protect our customers through rigorous quality standards, transaction auditing, and operational enablement.  
You will serve as the quality anchor and "connective tissue" of our fraud team. You won't just be clearing alerts; you will drive high decision standards across the entire function. Your mission is to establish and maintain robust QA frameworks, ensure every analyst makes high-quality, compliant decisions, and turn audit insights into actionable training, SOP updates, and process improvements

#### **What You'll Do**

* **Quality Assurance & Auditing (Primary Focus):** Perform regular, comprehensive audits of analyst transaction decisions, risk scores, and case notes to ensure consistency, accuracy, and strict adherence to compliance standards.
* **Root-Cause & Pattern Analysis:** Analyze QA audit data to identify recurring decision errors, knowledge gaps, and emerging fraud typologies, transforming findings into actionable team insights.
* **Calibration & Coaching:** Lead regular quality calibration sessions for the team and provide constructive feedback and targeted coaching to analysts to elevate decision quality.
* **Knowledge Architecture & SOPs:** Own and maintain the central "Source of Truth" (Knowledge Base) for Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), updating guidelines based on QA findings and evolving fraud tactics.
* **Training & Onboarding:** Design and deliver onboarding modules for new hires and ongoing "delta training" to address quality trends and process updates.
* **Process Excellence & System Gap Analysis:** Monitor team-wide quality metrics and SLAs. Act as a feedback loop between Operations and Product/Engineering to fix system limitations causing manual error or security risks.
* **Operational Visibility:** Aggregate and report QA scores, error trends, and compliance metrics to provide leadership with clear visibility into operational health.

#### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 5 years of experience in fraud operations, transaction monitoring, payments risk, or trust and safety. This must include hands-on experience developing Quality Assurance (QA) frameworks, sampling strategies, conducting audits, and coaching analysts.
* Proven expertise in evaluating transaction reviews, case documentation, and fraud determinations against established compliance and operational standards.
* Strong background in building or maintaining decision frameworks, QA scorecards, and SOP documentation.
* Hands-on background leveraging artificial intelligence technologies to streamline, enhance, and scale manual quality auditing workflows.
* Comfort reviewing complex transactions and conducting outbound customer verifications when needed.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of delivering constructive feedback and leading training sessions.
* High attention to detail and strong analytical skills to translate QA data into operational improvements.
* Ability to work in a high-volume, fast-paced operational environment while maintaining high quality standards.
* Willingness and flexibility to work across three rotating shifts as part of a 24×7 operations team.
* Experience in fintech, travel, payments, or e-commerce environments is strongly preferred.

title: Lead Treasury Analyst
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Treasury Analyst will join the Portfolio Strategy and Analytics team and support forecasts for the Wells Fargo Investment Portfolio across capital, interest rate risk, balance sheet, income, and liquidity under multiple scenarios. The role requires expertise in fixed-income modeling, Asset Liability Management, Interest Rate Risk, stress-testing, and model governance, along with strong partnership and matrix-management skills.

**In this role, you will:**

  

* Execute investment portfolio forecasting and analytics, including interest rate risk, valuation, balance sheet, income, capital, and liquidity analysis.
* Analyze month-over-month portfolio and forecast movements, identify material drivers, and translate results into clear business narratives.• Perform sensitivity, attribution, and assumption analysis to support balance sheet and interest rate risk management.
* Validate the accuracy, reasonableness, and consistency of data, assumptions, models, and outputs; maintain strong data quality and controls.
* Deliver recurring analyses accurately and in compliance with treasury risk management, regulatory, model governance, and audit requirements. Enhance forecasting, valuation, and analytics capabilities by documenting business requirements, conducting analytical testing, strengthening controls, and supporting new investment strategies.
* Improve processes through automation, Power BI, Python, AI, and other approved efficiency-enhancing solutions; provide recommendations to senior team members and management
* Act as Lead Consultant to finance, accounting and Business Line management on matters related to corporate treasury and related financial management
* Monitor and evaluate global market conditions, funding requirements, asset and liability management, liquidity risk management, capital management, financial performance management, capital, and related activities
* Provide overall advisory on treasury finance and risk strategies
* Ensure data quality and establish controlled processes
* Lead targeted projects including guiding other teammates
* Collaborate with Internal Audit, Corporate Risk Management and Model Governance teams as well as outside parties including regulatory agencies and accounting and consulting firms
* Make recommendations to more experienced group members and management
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
* Interact with internal customers
* Receive direction from leaders and exercise independent judgment while developing the knowledge to understand function, policies, procedures, and compliance requirements

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Treasury experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Experience analyzing, modeling, valuing, and forecasting fixed-income securities across multiple asset classes and scenarios.
* Strong analytical capabilities, business acumen, and attention to detail, with a consistent record of integrity and accuracy.
* Experience in Asset Liability Management, Interest Rate Risk, treasury analytics, or a comparable risk-management environment.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and exercise independent judgment in a complex, changing organization.
* Proven ability to build effective partnerships and collaborate across diverse stakeholder groups and organizational levels.
* Experience in process or business transformation, including controlled process design and implementation.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Excel and PowerPoint, with excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting, finance, economics, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education
* In-depth knowledge of fixed-income products, including mortgage-backed securities, structured products, municipal bonds, U.S. Treasury securities, and interest rate swaps.
* Experience with third-party fixed-income and risk platforms such as PolyPaths, QRM, ADCo, Bloomberg, or Calypso.
* Understanding of accounting, valuation, interest rate risk, stress testing, model governance, and the regulatory landscape for large financial institutions.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with familiarity in data science, databases, Power BI, and AI tools.
* Ability to investigate complex issues, distill findings into concise presentations, and recommend actionable solutions.
* Strong ownership mindset, with urgency, accountability, and the ability to drive outcomes with limited direction.
* Demonstrated adaptability, collaboration, and effectiveness in a matrixed team environment.
* Interest in learning and applying new analytics, automation, and AI capabilities within appropriate governance frameworks.

**Posting End Date:**

21 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

description:
Responsibilities

* **Improves** the effectiveness and efficiency of the Security Operations Center (SOC) by leading initiatives that enhance security orchestration, automation, and response ( **SOAR** ).

title: Senior Director
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Overview**

  
  

We are looking for a Data Solutions Architect with 8 to 10 years of experience in designing and delivering enterprise data solutions. The candidate should combine strong technical architecture expertise with hands-on solution building and client consulting skills. This role will lead business discovery, define solution architectures, develop proofs of concept, and guide implementation teams to deliver scalable data platforms and measurable business outcomes.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Solution Architecture & Building**

* Design end-to-end data solutions covering ingestion, integration, storage, processing, governance, and analytics.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs, solution blueprints, and delivery roadmaps.
* Build prototypes and proofs of concept to validate feasibility and demonstrate business value.
* Guide engineering teams through implementation, architecture reviews, and technical problem-solving.
* Ensure solutions meet scalability, performance, reliability, security, and cost requirements.
* Develop reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and solution accelerators.
  

  

**Consulting & Client Engagement**

* Lead discovery workshops to understand client objectives, data challenges, and existing technology landscapes.
* Assess data maturity and recommend modernization strategies and implementation plans.
* Advise clients on technology selection, architecture trade-offs, and build-versus-buy decisions.
* Present solution recommendations to business leaders and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales activities, including proposals, demonstrations, effort estimation, and statements of work.
* Define business success measures and connect technical solutions to expected outcomes.
* Collaborate with sales and delivery teams to establish scope, dependencies, and timelines
  

  

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Provide architecture oversight from discovery through production deployment.
* Work with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders.
* Establish standards for data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, and access control.
* Identify technical risks and recommend mitigation measures.
* Mentor team members and strengthen architecture and engineering practices
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of overall experience in data engineering, enterprise data solutions, or related roles, including experience in architecture and client-facing consulting.
* Proven ability to deliver solutions from requirements gathering and architecture design through implementation and production rollout.
* Strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Python, data modeling, and ETL/ELT development.
* Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Stack, Azure.
* Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery, or Redshift.
* Knowledge of distributed processing, pipeline orchestration, batch and streaming architectures, and API integration.
* Understanding of data governance, security, privacy, and performance optimization.
* Experience preparing architecture documentation, technical proposals, estimates, and implementation roadmaps.
* Strong communication, presentation, consulting, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance business priorities with technical feasibility and delivery constraints.
  

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Enterprise data modernization and cloud migration experience.
* Exposure to data solutions supporting AI/ML, GenAI, and advanced analytics.
* Familiarity with DataOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and automated testing.
* Experience building reusable or industry-specific solution accelerators.
* Relevant cloud or data architecture certifications.
  

  

**Educational Qualification**

  
  

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  
  

**Key Skills**

  
  

Data Architecture | Solution Building | Client Consulting | Cloud Data Platforms | Data Engineering | SQL | Python | Data Modeling | ETL/ELT | Data Governance | Pre-sales | Stakeholder Management | Technical Leadership

title: Sr Mgr Business Application
description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------

This is a rare opportunity to shape the architectural backbone of a global pharmaceutical leader at a moment when data and AI are redefining how medicines reach patients. As Senior Manager, you'll lead the Data Lake Operations across Teva's entire data platform — setting the direction for Databricks and Azure, designing the foundations that make AI and machine learning production-ready at scale, and establishing the data governance standards that keep it all trustworthy. You won't be executing someone else's blueprint; you'll be drawing it, working across business and technology leadership to turn a sprawling data landscape into a coherent, well-governed platform that teams actually want to build on. For a leader who wants breadth, autonomy, and visible impact — where the systems you design ultimately support better health outcomes for millions of people.

title: SQA Manager
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

Gallagher Center of Excellence is seeking a Senior QA Engineer with 10–15 years of relevant experience to lead quality engineering for Gallagher Drive analytics products. The role will define and govern the QA strategy across Power BI reports and dashboards, data and ETL pipelines, APIs, and supporting applications. The Senior QA Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership, establish repeatable QA processes and controls, guide automation architecture using Python, PyTest, and Playwright, drive risk-based release readiness, mentor QA resources, and partner with business, product, development, data, and reporting leaders. This is a senior technical individual-contributor role; direct people-management responsibility should be confirmed separately by the hiring manager.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

* **QA Strategy and Governance:** Define the end-to-end quality strategy, operating model, risk-based test approach, entry and exit criteria, evidence standards, release gates, sign-off controls, SOPs, checklists, and regression governance across analytics products.
* **Test Leadership and Assurance:** Lead planning and assurance for functional, integration, system, regression, data, API, ETL, reporting, smoke, performance, security-related, and release validation; ensure appropriate coverage across critical business journeys.
* **Power BI Quality Engineering:** Establish testing standards for data accuracy, DAX calculations, semantic models, filters, slicers, interactions, drill-through, navigation, refresh behavior, role-based access, visual standards, accessibility, and performance.
* **Data and ETL Quality Leadership:** Define source-to-target reconciliation controls and data-quality rules across source systems, ETL pipelines, Snowflake or equivalent warehouse layers, semantic models, and reporting outputs.
* **Automation Strategy and Architecture:** Define scalable automation architecture using Python, PyTest, Playwright, API frameworks, reusable libraries, test-data utilities, reporting, and CI/CD integration. Prioritize automation based on risk, business value, repeatability, effort, and maintainability.
* **Visual Regression and Baseline Governance:** Establish Playwright or comparable browser automation for Power BI navigation, screenshot capture, visual comparison, threshold management, approved baseline updates, and defect triage for unexpected changes.
* **Azure DevOps Traceability and Controls:** Establish requirements-to-test-to-defect traceability, evidence standards, dashboards, workflow controls, defect templates, and execution reporting in Azure DevOps or an approved comparable tool.
* **Defect Governance and Root Cause Analysis:** Lead defect triage, severity and priority alignment, defect-ageing reviews, root-cause analysis, corrective-action tracking, fix verification, and learning from escaped defects.
* **Release Readiness and Executive Reporting:** Provide concise decision-oriented reporting on requirements and test coverage, execution progress, defect trends, open high-severity risks, automation coverage, dependencies, residual exposure, and release recommendations.
* **Cross-Functional Quality Leadership:** Partner with product owners, business analysts, engineering leaders, data engineers, Power BI developers, architects, scrum masters, security teams, and business stakeholders to make requirements testable and address quality risks early.
* **Capability Building and Knowledge Sustainability:** Mentor QA engineers, conduct reviews, define reusable templates and assets, maintain current operating procedures, facilitate knowledge transfer, improve backup readiness, and reduce dependency on individual subject-matter experts.
* **Continuous Improvement and Innovation:** Use quality metrics, defect patterns, delivery retrospectives, and value-stream analysis to identify process improvements. Evaluate AI-assisted testing, specification-driven approaches, and new tooling through governed proofs of concept.
* **Compliance, Security and Test Data:** Ensure QA practices follow approved privacy, masking, access-control, environment, open-source package, and secure test-data requirements.
* **Stakeholder and Delivery Management:** Manage competing QA priorities across products, communicate trade-offs and resource constraints, escalate blockers early, and align testing investment with customer and business outcomes.

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

* 10–15 years of software quality assurance experience, including technical leadership for complex data, analytics, reporting, API, and application testing.
* Demonstrated experience defining QA strategy, governance, standards, entry and exit criteria, evidence expectations, release gates, and sign-off recommendations.
* Advanced SQL and data-validation capability covering reconciliation, profiling, joins, aggregations, transformation-rule validation, and investigation of data discrepancies.
* Strong Power BI quality-assurance experience covering DAX, semantic models, data, interactions, role-based access, refresh, performance, visual standards, and regression governance.
* Strong data and ETL testing experience with Snowflake, Azure Synapse, SQL Server, SSMS, ADF, or comparable cloud data platforms and pipeline technologies.
* Hands-on Python and PyTest experience, including reusable framework design, fixtures, utilities, assertions, reporting, and automation maintainability.
* Experience with Playwright or a comparable browser automation framework for UI and visual regression testing and baseline governance.
* Experience with API testing, CI/CD integration, source control, automated execution reporting, and controlled adoption of open-source packages.
* Advanced Azure DevOps experience for test management, requirements traceability, defect governance, dashboards, sprint visibility, and quality reporting.
* Experience leading defect triage, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, release-readiness reviews, and executive or leadership-level quality reporting.
* Ability to mentor QA engineers, influence without formal authority, lead cross-functional quality discussions, and create sustainable knowledge-transfer practices.
* Strong business acumen, strategic communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, analytical thinking, and evidence-based decision-making.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience establishing or scaling a QA Center of Excellence or shared quality-engineering capability.
* Experience with AI-assisted testing, specification-driven test generation, automated defect creation, or governed use of enterprise AI platforms.
* Performance testing experience using JMeter, k6, or comparable tools; accessibility testing knowledge is an advantage.
* Knowledge of data lineage, metadata, observability, data contracts, masking, access controls, and secure non-production environments.
* Experience measuring automation return, manual-effort reduction, defect leakage, coverage, cycle time, and release confidence.
* ISTQB Advanced/Test Manager, CSQE, Microsoft Power BI, Snowflake, Azure, Python, Agile/Scrum, Lean Six Sigma, or related certification or training.

**Education And Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, data, or a related technical discipline is preferred.
* 10–15 years of relevant QA experience. Talent Acquisition and Compensation should confirm the final career level, career band, and education wording before publication.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview
  
  
DNEG is seeking a security professional to assess applications, cloud services, AI use
  
cases, and third-party tools before and during their use across the company. The role
  
combines practical security architecture reviews with hands-on evaluation of security
  
solutions. The successful candidate will document risks, recommend workable controls,
  
and support informed approval decisions.
  
  
Mandatory Requirements and Expectations
  
  

* Own defined security reviews independently and escalate material risks or

complex decisions to senior security stakeholders.
  

* Provide clear, evidence-based recommendations that account for security risk,

business use, and implementation effort.
  

* Work closely with engineering, cloud, product, and other internal teams to

understand designs and agree on practical actions.
  

* Maintain accurate review records, decisions, conditions, and follow-up actions for

the security approval process.
  

* Communicate findings constructively to both technical and non-technical

stakeholders.
  
Duties and Operational Responsibilities
  

* Review application and API designs for authentication, authorization, data

protection, secure integration, and common attack paths.
  

* Perform threat modelling for new systems and significant changes, and

recommend controls that can be implemented and verified.
  

* Assess cloud architectures and configurations, including identity, network

exposure, secrets, encryption, logging, and workload security.
  

* Review proposed AI applications and services for data exposure, access control,

unsafe outputs, prompt injection, and third-party dependencies.
  

* Evaluate third-party tools before company use by reviewing their security

posture, data flows, permissions, integrations, and relevant assurance evidence.
  

* Plan and run proof of concepts for application, cloud, and AI security tools using

agreed evaluation criteria; document effectiveness, integration needs, and
  
limitations.
  

* Prepare concise risk assessments and recommendations, including proposed

conditions or remediation needed before approval.
  

* Track findings with system and service owners, validate remediation evidence,

and identify unresolved risks for escalation.
  
  

* Contribute to security standards, review checklists, and reusable design

guidance to improve consistency across assessments.
  
  
Mandatory Job Requirements
  
  
A successful candidate should demonstrate the following experience and capabilities:
  

* Approximately five years of relevant experience in application security, cloud

security, security engineering, or security architecture.
  

* Experience reviewing application designs and applying secure development

practices, threat modelling, and risk-based remediation.
  

* Working knowledge of application and API security testing, including code,

dependency, and dynamic testing approaches.
  

* Hands-on understanding of security controls in at least one major cloud platform,

particularly identity, networking, data protection, and monitoring.
  

* Ability to evaluate unfamiliar technologies through proof of concepts, define

success criteria, and present a balanced recommendation.
  

* Experience assessing third-party products or services, including how they

access, process, store, and share company or client data.
  

* Working knowledge of security risks in AI-enabled applications and the controls

used to address them.
  

* Strong written communication and the ability to work with engineers and

stakeholders to resolve identified risks.
  
Desirable Experience
  

* Direct experience assessing generative AI applications, including retrieval-based

systems or applications that use external tools.
  

* Experience with security assurance reports, vendor questionnaires, and

recognized security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, or OWASP
  
guidance.
  

* Experience evaluating or operating application security, cloud security, or AI

security tooling.
  
  
Education
  
  

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity,

or equivalent practical experience is desirable.
  

* Relevant security or cloud certifications are desirable but are not a substitute for

demonstrated practical experience.

description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a Cyber Security Incident Analyst to independently own and manage cybersecurity incidents from initial detection through to resolution. You will monitor and manage incidents received through multiple intake queues, including SIEM, SOAR, Incident Portal, DLP and VFCZ VBU customer incident queues.  
This role requires autonomy, sound judgement and the ability to progress complex investigations with minimal supervision. You will assess risk and business impact, perform detailed technical analysis, make informed escalation decisions and ensure incidents are managed consistently in line with Vodafone Cyber Security Incident Management standards.  
A strong focus on analytical depth, timely risk-based escalation and accurate, audit-ready documentation is essential.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Independently own and manage cybersecurity incidents throughout the end-to-end incident lifecycle.  
Perform advanced incident triage, validation and prioritisation with minimal supervision.  
Assess incident severity, risk and potential impact on customers, services, data and operations.  
Conduct detailed technical investigations by correlating alerts, logs and indicators of compromise (IoCs).  
Identify and appropriately close false positives and low-risk events without unnecessary escalation.  
Progress investigations and determine when escalation or specialist assistance is required.  
Coordinate incident response activities across CSOC, Threat Intelligence, Forensics/CERT, IT and Network teams.  
Maintain accurate, comprehensive and audit-ready documentation throughout each incident.  
Actively manage incidents through to resolution in accordance with applicable SLAs and response standards.  
Provide clear, concise and risk-focused incident updates to incident managers and relevant stakeholders.

**Who you are**
---------------

You have proven experience in Cyber Security Operations, a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Incident Response or Cyber Defence.  
You have hands-on experience leading cybersecurity incident triage and investigations in production environments.  
You can independently take ownership of incidents from initial identification through to resolution.  
You have excellent analytical capabilities and can assess complex alerts, logs and events to determine their actual impact.  
You have a solid understanding of common cyber threats and attack techniques.  
You understand the cybersecurity incident management lifecycle, including escalation and problem handover.  
You have experience coordinating effectively across multiple technical and non-technical teams during incidents.  
You communicate clearly with stakeholders and maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

Take end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents and contribute directly to protecting customers, services, data and operations.  
Work collaboratively with specialist teams including CSOC, Threat Intelligence, Forensics/CERT, IT and Network teams.  
Gain exposure to complex cybersecurity incidents across multiple intake channels and production environments.  
Develop experience in risk-based decision-making, stakeholder communication and incident coordination.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

Advanced cybersecurity incident triage, investigation and prioritisation.  
Alert, log and IoC correlation across security environments.  
Risk and business-impact assessment.  
Incident escalation and cross-functional response coordination.  
Audit-ready cybersecurity incident documentation.  
Stakeholder communication during complex and high-priority incidents.  
End-to-end incident lifecycle and SLA management.

title: Workday Analyst
description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

  

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

Solventum is seeking a highly motivated **Workday Analyst** to join our team and provide ongoing support for various Workday modules, including **HCM Core, Recruiting and Compensation** . The Workday Analyst will support 2 to 3 of the above modules and work closely with the US-based team to drive system initiatives, deliver improvements, and provide day-to-day support for Workday-related activities.

In this role, the analyst will be responsible for managing support tickets, resolving issues, assisting with system configurations, performing testing, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure the optimal use of Workday functionality. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of Workday, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work across time zones with the US team.

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**

  

* **Workday Recruiting:**
  + Serve as the first point of contact for the US-based team, addressing Workday-related support tickets and providing timely resolutions for any system issues.
  + Configure and maintain Workday Recruiting processes such as job requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview scheduling, offer management and Onboarding
  + Strong experience resolving configuration and functional issues across recruiting and onboarding modules, as well as touchpoints with other modules.
  + Collaborate with HR and Talent Acquisition teams to optimize recruiting workflows
  + Ensure the integrity of data across modules by monitoring system performance, investigating discrepancies, and implementing solutions.
  + Document and track issues, solutions, and improvements to provide a knowledge base for future support.
  Strong expertise in designing complex Workday calculated fields, with a solid understanding of business objects, data sources, and the appropriate placement of calculations.

  

* **Workday Compensation:**
  + Configure and maintain compensation plans, packages, eligibility rules, compensation grades and grade profiles, compensation basis and related reference data.
  + Support compensation transactions within staffing and worker lifecycle processes, including hire, change job, promotion and compensation change events.
  + Analyze compensation configuration issues, eligibility outcomes and process routing; recommend corrective actions and sustainable design improvements.
  + Collaborate with Compensation, HR and Payroll stakeholders to validate requirements, assess downstream impacts and support accurate, controlled deployment.
  Support the execution of global compensation processes, including Annual Review Process, AIP and other compensation initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

  

* **Collaboration with US-Based Team:**
  + Work closely with the US-based Workday team to understand business requirements, provide technical expertise, and ensure system configurations are aligned with organizational goals.
  + Assist in the implementation and execution of new features, functionality, and module upgrades by following established processes.
  Participate in cross-team meetings with the US team to align on priorities, project timelines, and best practices.

  

* **Workday Configuration & System Maintenance:**
  + Assist with the configuration and maintenance of Workday HCM, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, and Reporting modules based on business needs.
  + Support system updates, testing, and deployment activities to ensure smooth transitions during Workday upgrades or new releases.
  Ensure that workflows, business processes, and security roles are accurately configured to meet the needs of the business.

  

* **Project Support & Initiative Execution:**
  + Collaborate with the US-based team to drive global initiatives and provide support for ongoing projects, including process improvements and system enhancements.
  + Participate in system testing for new releases, changes, and enhancements, ensuring that all configurations meet business requirements.
  Assist with documenting project requirements, processes, and procedures to ensure proper system utilization.

  

* **Reporting & Data Analysis:**
  + Develop and maintain Workday reports and dashboards to support HR, payroll, and business requirements.
  + Assist with extracting, validating, and analyzing data to support business decision-making and compliance requirements.
  Collaborate with the reporting team to create custom reports or modify existing ones based on user feedback.

  

* **Training & Knowledge Sharing:**
  + Provide training and guidance to HR and business teams on Workday best practices, system functionality, and process improvements.
  Maintain up-to-date documentation on configurations, processes, and system changes to facilitate knowledge sharing across teams.

  

* **Continuous Improvement:**
  + Identify opportunities for process improvement and suggest enhancements to increase system efficiency and user satisfaction.
  Proactively address potential issues by analyzing trends, preparing solutions, and collaborating with the US team to resolve them.

  

**Your Skills and Expertise**

  

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  

* **Experience:** 5+ years of experience in Workday support or HRIS roles with exposure to multiple Workday modules.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in human resources, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Workday Expertise:** Solid experience supporting multiple Workday modules (HCM Core, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Reporting).
* **Analytical Skills:** Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify system issues, resolve problems, and offer solutions.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Proficient in Workday’s reporting tools, Calc Fields, security configuration, and business process configuration.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across different time zones.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong problem-solving abilities to address support tickets, improve system functionality, and handle system issues efficiently.
* **Project Management:** Experience supporting system upgrades, new functionality, and process improvements.

  

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

* **Workday Certifications:** Workday certifications in relevant modules (e.g., Workday HCM Core, Workday Compensation, Workday Recruiting) are highly desirable.
* **Global Workday Experience:** Experience in supporting global Workday implementations or managing cross-country configurations.
* **Reporting Expertise:** Strong experience in creating and maintaining custom reports and dashboards in Workday.

  

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid**

title: Responsible AI Solution Risk Assessor
description:
**Overview**  

Are you passionate about advancing the positive impact of AI on a global scale? In this position, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our AI initiatives are implemented responsibly and effectively.

Our Trust and Integrity Protection (TrIP) team works with other parts of Microsoft to ensure we continue to be one of the most trusted companies in the world. We are seeking a detail-oriented and principled Responsible AI Solution Risk Assessor to be part of a team evaluating AI use cases across our organization. This role is critical in ensuring that AI solutions are developed and deployed in alignment with Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, and ethical standards. You will work closely with the Office of Responsible AI and other governance bodies to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with AI technologies.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  
**Responsibilities**  

* Risk Assessment Ownership: Lead the Responsible AI risk assessment process for AI projects within your purview.
* Use Case Evaluation: Analyze proposed AI solutions for ethical, privacy, and security risks, including identifying sensitive use cases (e.g., facial recognition, biometric analysis, or legally sensitive applications).
* Escalation Management: Determine when use cases require escalation to internal review boards such as the Deployment Safety Board or other governance entities.
* Approval Coordination: Ensure all necessary approvals are obtained before development or deal sign-off, maintaining alignment with internal Responsible AI policies.
* Documentation & Compliance: Maintain thorough documentation of risk assessments, approvals, and mitigation strategies to support audit readiness and compliance.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with product teams, legal, compliance, and engineering to ensure risk considerations are addressed early in the development lifecycle.
* Policy Integration: Translate Responsible AI policies into actionable assessment criteria and workflows.
* Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the evolution of risk assessment frameworks and tools based on emerging technologies and regulatory changes.

  
**Qualifications**  

### **Required Qualifications (RQs)**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Ethics, Law, Risk Management, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in risk assessment, compliance, or governance roles, preferably in AI or emerging technologies.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act).
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.

### **Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Risk Management, Engineering, Government Intelligence, Security, or Information Technology, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Risk Management in the context of Operations, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Analyst, Consulting, Auditing, Privacy, Security, Compliance, Government Intelligence, and/or Finance OR equivalent experience.
* Experience with internal governance processes such as AI review boards or safety panels.
* Knowledge of privacy-preserving technologies and bias mitigation techniques.
* Background in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance, government).
* Certifications in AI ethics, compliance, or risk management.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Cybersecurity Professional
description:
**Job Title**: Cybersecurity Professional  
**Job Location**: Anywhere in India  
  
**Role Overview:**

As a Product and Solution Security Expert (PSSE) in Grid Software, you are the cybersecurity backbone for mission-critical Operational Technology (OT) deployments. You will act as the trusted security authority interfacing between our R&D organizations, project engineering teams, and major transmission/distribution system operators (TSOs/DSOs).

Your mission is to secure our advanced SCADA, ADMS, and grid automation solutions against evolving threat landscapes without compromising the strict availability and real-time performance demands of critical infrastructure. You will champion our security posture—safeguarding legacy integration layers while driving robust, secure architectures for modern deployments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Customer & Stakeholder Cybersecurity Leadership: Serve as the primary security interface for high-stakes customer projects, leading security alignment workshops, architecture reviews, and defending our security posture against rigorous customer specifications and regulatory frameworks (e.g., NIS2, IEC 62443).
* Secure Architecture & Integration: Oversee the secure design, hardening, and network segmentation of SCADA/EMS solutions deployed in customer environments. Ensure seamless integration of identity and access management (IAM), secure logging, and patch management workflows.
* Risk & Vulnerability Management: Apply our post-freeze risk scorecard methodologies. Evaluate 3rd-party software vulnerabilities using Environmental CVSS, reachability analysis (VEX), and exploit probability (EPSS/KEV) to advise Project Managers and Product Security Officers (PSSOs) on risk-based release decisions.
* Compliance & Certification Support: Drive adherence to IEC 62443-3-3 standards across project lifecycles, preparing documentation, security targets, and evidence for customer audits and factory/site acceptance tests (FAT/SAT).
* Incident Preparedness & Incident Engineering: Collaborate with project teams and incident response units to define fail-open contingency designs, ensuring grid availability takes precedence while containment and remediation occur safely.

**Key Deliverables:**

1. Project Security Architecture & Risk Assessments: Comprehensive security design documents, threat models (STRIDE), and system-specific risk assessments for every assigned critical infrastructure project.

2. Security-Gate Sign-offs: Authoritative security reviews and gate approvals at key project milestones (Architecture, FAT, SAT, Go-Live), backed by quantified risk-mitigation plans.

3. Vulnerability & Patch Management Runbooks: Tailored operational guidelines and risk-scoring rationales for customers handling 3rd-party component patching in live SCADA environments.

4. Regulatory & Audit Artifacts: Audit-ready compliance packages mapping project implementations to IEC 62443 and national critical infrastructure protection (CIP) standards.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Zero Unmitigated Critical Exposures: High-risk vulnerabilities and architectural gaps are identified, triaged, and mitigated proactively before system integration or customer sign-off.
* Trusted Advisor Status: You earn the absolute confidence of customer CISOs and Bid- and Project Managers by explaining complex OT cybersecurity trade-offs with clarity, pragmatism, and authority.
* Resilient Delivery Without Compromise: Grid availability and performance are never sacrificed; your security frameworks ensure that fail-open mechanisms and robust risk management protect the grid while maintaining operational uptime.
* Seamless Collaboration: Engineering teams, PSSOs, and external partners view you not as a compliance bottleneck, but as an enabler who embeds security cleanly into the delivery lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity within Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA, or critical infrastructure sectors.
* Deep working knowledge of IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and European cybersecurity regulations (e.g., NIS2, CRA).
* Hands-on experience with threat modeling, secure network architectures (Purdue Model, firewalls, datadiodes), Identiy and Access Management concepts and vulnerability triaging tools.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English

title: Product Director- MXDR
description:
**Director, MXDR Product**

**Level**

Director

  

**Function**

Product Engineering & Development — MXDR (Managed Extended Detection & Response)

  

**Experience**

15–20 years, including 5+ years leading a security or infrastructure product at scale

**Role Summary**
================

The Director, MXDR Product owns the MXDR product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, delivery, and outcomes. This person sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, security operations, sales, and customer success, converting technical capability into a coherent product that customers trust and buy. They will partner closely with the Senior Architect (who continues to own technical architecture) while taking full ownership of product direction, delivery commitments, cross-functional alignment, and executive/customer communication.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Product Ownership & Strategy**
--------------------------------

* Own the MXDR product roadmap end-to-end — define priorities, sequence releases, and make explicit trade-off calls between customer asks, competitive pressure, and technical debt.
* Translate market and customer signal (win/loss reviews, analyst reports, competitive intelligence, compliance requirements like FedRAMP/SOC 2) into a defensible product strategy.
* Own the business case for major initiatives — cost, timeline, staffing, and expected outcome — before they go to engineering, closing the gap between "good architecture" and "fundable roadmap."

**Delivery Ownership**
----------------------

* Own delivery predictability: turn architecture and design work into resourced, sequenced, trackable delivery plans with realistic timelines.
* Run the cadence that keeps delivery visible — regular progress reviews, clear status reporting (RAG/roadmap-vs-actual), and early escalation of risk rather than late surprises.
* Partner with the Senior Architect and engineering leads to convert technical designs into shippable phases with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**
------------------------------------------

* Be the primary product point of contact for CTO, executive leadership, and key customers — comfortable presenting roadmap, risk, and trade-offs to non-technical and executive audiences.
* Manage the inevitable tension between sales commitments, customer requests, and engineering capacity — and be the one who says no, with a clear rationale, when needed.
* Build and maintain trust with cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, SOC/security operations, sales, marketing, customer success, compliance) so the product roadmap reflects real constraints from every side, not just engineering's.

**Ownership & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Take end-to-end accountability for product outcomes — not just what was designed or built, but what shipped, what customers adopted, and what moved the business forward.
* Proactively surface risk (technical, delivery, market, compliance) rather than waiting to be asked — and bring a recommended path forward, not just a problem.
* Own post-release outcomes: adoption, customer feedback, support burden, and whether the product delivered the value it was built for.

**Domain & Technical Fluency**
------------------------------

* Be fluent enough in MXDR/SOC concepts (detection engineering, threat hunting, SIEM/UEBA/ITDR, incident response workflows, MITRE ATT&CK) to have a credible technical conversation with architects, customers, and analysts — without needing to be the one designing the models.
* Understand the compliance and certification landscape relevant to security products (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, GDPR) well enough to factor it into roadmap decisions early, not as an afterthought.
* Expertise in building AI based SDLC using AI tools.

**AI/ML, LLM, and Innovation Strategy**

* **GenAI & LLM Integration:** Design the architectural blueprint for embedding Generative AI and LLMs (via commercial APIs like OpenAI/Anthropic or open-source models like Llama/Mistral) into our existing products to deliver next-generation customer value.
* **Machine Learning Pipelines:** Leverage the **Python** ecosystem to oversee the creation of scalable ML data pipelines, MLOps frameworks, and predictive modeling features that enhance our application's intelligent capabilities.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Architect advanced RAG systems combining **Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch as a vector database)** and SQL to enable high-performance, context-aware semantic search and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* **AI Security & Governance:** Establish enterprise-wide compliance, data privacy (preventing PII leakage into LLMs), and ethical guardrails for AI usage, ensuring alignment with emerging global AI regulations.
* **Internal AI Automation:** Lead initiatives to leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and automated testing tools to improve overall engineering team velocity and code quality.

**Executive Technology Strategy & Enterprise Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Long-Term Technical Vision**: Define and execute a 3-to-5-year technology roadmap that scales with the company’s business growth, shifting engineering from a reactive delivery unit to a proactive business driver.
* **Polyglot Stack Governance:** Establish modern architectural guardrails and engineering standards for our composite ecosystem—ensuring seamless, secure integration between enterprise Angular frontends, distributed Python services, and high-performance .NET Web APIs.
* **Enterprise Data & Search Strategy:** Architect the future state of our data layer; guide principal engineers in optimizing high-transaction SQL databases (replication, partitioning) alongside massive Elastic Stack (ELK) clusters utilized for real-time search, analytics, and observability.
* **R&D and Innovation Leadership**: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI/ML capabilities to determine their business viability, running targeted Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) to maintain market competitiveness.
* **Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity:** Own the design and regular testing of global Disaster Recovery (DR) and High Availability (HA) strategies to guarantee maximum business continuity and strict uptime SLA compliance.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Required**
------------

* 15–20 years total experience, with a meaningful portion in product development or product leadership roles for security, infrastructure, or SaaS platforms.
* 5+ years operating at Director level or equivalent scope — owning a product line's roadmap, delivery, and business outcomes, not just a feature area.
* Demonstrated track record of taking a product from architecture/vision to shipped, adopted reality — able to speak to specific products they've owned end-to-end.
* **Technical Breadth:** Previous hands-on architecture experience in enterprise Microsoft environments (.NET/C#) blended with open-source ecosystems (Python, Angular).
* Strong delivery discipline: experience running structured delivery cadences (roadmaps, sprint/release tracking, RAG reporting) and holding cross-functional teams to commitments.
* Excellent communicator — comfortable presenting to CTO/executive leadership and to customers, and able to translate deep technical detail into business language and back.
* Experience working alongside (not replacing) a strong technical architect — clear sense of where product ownership ends and architecture ownership begins, and how to partner rather than compete.
* Working knowledge of security operations concepts: detection & response, threat intelligence, SIEM/XDR/UEBA, identity security, or adjacent domains.
* Compliance & Governance Alignment: Ensure all engineering processes, data handling pipelines, and architectural patterns adhere strictly to industry certifications relevant to a scaling mid-size company (**SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA**, etc.).

**Preferred**
-------------

* Prior experience specifically in MXDR, MDR, SIEM, XDR, or broader security operations product lines.
* Experience navigating compliance-driven sales cycles (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and their impact on roadmap and architecture decisions.
* Experience building or scaling a product function — hiring and mentoring product managers, delivery leads, or program managers.
* Familiarity with modern detection engineering concepts (behavioral analytics, ML-based detection, identity threat detection) sufficient to evaluate technical proposals critically.

title: Process Re-engineering - Payments
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Process Re-engineering - Payments.**

**In this role, you will:**

* International Organization for Standardization 20022 is a market driven mandatory, global payments directive which will migrate all payment messages from existing MT (Message Type) format into the new MX (SWIFT Message Type defined in ISO 20022) format. Additionally, as part of SWIFT International Organization for Standardization 20022 MX (SWIFT - Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication Message Type defined in ISO 20022) migration, party and agent name and address information must comply to structured format by November 2026. Payment messages that do not comply to structured format will be rejected. The scale of the programme covers over 50 sites in which Markets and Securities Services Operations have a presence and over 40 unique systems which generate payments.
* We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join the International Organization for Standardization Data workstream in delivering Structured Name and Address mandate by November 2026. The ideal candidate will have prior experience working on large-scale projects within the payments or settlements domain. This role involves extensive data analysis, requirements gathering and validation, coordinate and facilitate discussions with diverse teams across multiple geographical locations, as well as supporting testing for global rollouts.

* Perform data analysis related to payments, settlement instructions, accounts, and static data. Identify SSI (Standard Settlement Instructions) / static data issue, provide remediation recommendations and/or analysis that helps to identify solutions.
* Gather, validate and document business requirements. Facilitate discussions with relevant teams across multiple geographical locations (e.g. Markets and Securities Services Technology, Markets and Securities Services Operations, Static & Reference Data teams, etc) where necessary and ensure requirements are clearly understood by delivery teams.
* Contribute to project planning and execution and ensure alignment with overall programme plan and objectives. Work with the Test Manager and Subject Matter Experts to co-ordinate the preparation of SIT (Systems Integration Testing) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) test cases.
* Work with Markets and Securities Services technology and Markets and Securities Services Operations to ensure complete and robust testing and go-live approach is supported.
* Work the International Organization for Standardization regional leads and / or Markets and Securities Services Operations to ensure business readiness is complete before go-live.
* Responsible for highlighting risks, issues and impact to project timelines to Workstream Lead / International Organization for Standardization Programme.

**To be successful, you will:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree preferred.
* 8+ Years of experience in business analysis and Payments.
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst in the payments or settlements domain, preferably within a large-scale project environment.
* Strong capability in handling and analyzing large datasets with attention to detail. Familiar with Business Analysis & Concepts, Process Related documentation and User Testing.
* Expertise in payments with MT (Message Type) and MX (SWIFT Message Type defined in ISO 20022) International Organization for Standardization 20022 format.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Organized individual who can manage multiple priorities with tight timelines. Excellent written communication skills to clearly and concisely present requirements in a manner appropriate to the audience.
* Proactive and self-starting and able to work autonomously on projects. Strong communicator and excellent at building relationships with peers, stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Experience and knowledge of the trade and payment lifecycle is ideal. Understanding of the Markets and Securities Services business. Understanding of the regulatory and market landscape

**Hsbc.Com/Careers**

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. The Junior OT Security Engineer supports the Operational Technology (OT) Security program by assisting in the management, monitoring, and continuous improvement of security technologies that protect manufacturing and industrial environments.



This role is focused on foundational OT cybersecurity operations, execution of Run \& Maintain (R\&M) activities, and maintaining strong asset visibility across OT environments. The engineer will work under the guidance of senior OT engineers to execute operational tasks, improve data quality, and help sustain OT security controls at scale.



This position plays a critical role in maintaining the health, accuracy, and reliability of OT security platforms and metrics, ensuring the program continues to mature and operate effectively.

* Support daily operations of OT security technologies, with a primary focus on OT asset visibility and detection platform, maintenance, and data quality
* Execute Run \& Maintain (R\&M) activities, including device classification, asset reconciliation, exception handling, and rule tuning
* Assist with maintaining high\-quality OT asset inventory
* Perform basic troubleshooting for discovery configurations, integrations, and platform health issues, escalating as needed
* Monitor OT security alerts, identify anomalies, and support investigation and escalation processes
* Support ongoing improvement of OT metrics (e.g., asset designation, collector health, visibility gaps) through continuous data cleanup and validation

* Support improvements, changes, and configurations to our security suite.
* Provide backup and support for other security capabilities managed by the Security Engineering Team.
* Manage and track security metrics to be included in Monthly Operating Reviews (MORs), Project Status Reviews (PSRs), and workshops.
* Up to 10% travel required based on business and project needs, including visits to manufacturing and distribution sites.


**Required Qualifications and Competencies:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 1–3 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, or a related technical discipline
* Foundational understanding of networking concepts, including:IP addressing, subnets, routing, and switching fundamentals

**Preferred Qualifications and Competencies:**

* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills for troubleshooting and data validation
* Effective communication and collaboration across IT, OT, and security teams
